title: Automatically clean shape data passed to ExtrudeGeometry
body:
**Description**

Before triangulating a shape, ExtrudeGeometry now welds any index-adjacent points within a small hardcoded distance threshold of each other. This resolves common triangulation artifacts caused by improperly formatted shape data.

Also improved variable names and commenting in the affected files.

Related issue: #20317
Original PR with discussion: #30698

**Screenshots**

Before change (prominent triangulation errors):
![corner-artifacts](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/686fcd37-8359-419c-b1b2-a2f8d9b656dc)

With vertex welding (bevelOffset is negative, same settings, no errors):
![with-fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1bd9ee81-542e-42ef-8a96-420713773d91)

Triangulation still breaks if you use physically invalid parameters (bevelOffset negative and larger than the 2D thickness of the contour shape):
![invalid-offsets](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cf4f7306-92ca-4283-82b0-0888ab4bd8d8)

ground_truth.body: Rename `cleanPoints` to `mergePoints` to accurately reflect the function's purpose of merging duplicate vertices, as the current name misrepresents its behavior.
Use strict equality === instead of ==. The checklist requires using === and !== for all comparisons.
Consider adding a comment explaining why cleaned vertices are used here instead of the original `vertices` and `holes`. This improves understanding of the geometric preprocessing impact.
